name: Level caps by badges
author: PokePat
description: Pokémon cannot level past a cap with battle Exp.: the cap is the level of the next Gym Leader, then the League, and after the Champion there is no cap. A Pokémon at the cap stops one Exp. point before the next level; Pokémon already above it keep their Exp. and gain none. The caps can be changed in PokePat after installing.
